name: Someone to Wait In
tagline: We sit in your house for the parcel or the plumber. Between 8 and 6, like they said.
summary: A named waiter with ID sits in your home for a half day or a full day.
concept: Deliveries come between 8 and 6. You have somewhere to be. We cover the gap.
who_its_for: Anyone waiting for a delivery, an engineer or a plumber who can't take the day off.
how_it_works: Choose a half day (4 hours) or a full day (8 to 6).
We send a named waiter with ID.
They let in only the person you named, sign for things and tell you what happened.

page.headline: Someone to wait in
page.intro: We sit in your house for the parcel or the plumber. Between 8 and 6, like they said.

sections.title: Prices
sections.body: Half day (4 hours) £45. Full day (8 to 6) £80.

sections.title: Who comes
sections.body: A named waiter with ID. You'll know who it is before they arrive.

sections.title: What they do and don't
sections.body: They sign for things. They do not let anyone else in or make decisions about repairs.

faq.a: Half day (4 hours) is £45. Full day (8 to 6) is £80.
A named waiter with ID, told to you in advance.

faq.q: Will they let the plumber in?
faq.a: Yes, if you have named them. Nobody else gets in.

faq.q: Can they decide about the repair?
faq.a: No. They'll tell you what's said and you decide.

faq.q: How much notice do you need?

faq.a: Full refund up to 24 hours before. None after that.
Your address, within 30 miles of us.
